zh.title: 國防部：5架次中國軍機越臺灣海峽中線 國軍監控應處
zh.summary: 國防部統計6架次中國軍機及12艘中國軍艦，5架次越中線，國軍監控應處。
body: 國防部11月23日公佈共機艦動態，統計自22日上午6時至23日上午6時，偵獲6架次中國軍機及12艘中國軍艦。其中5架次軍機逾越臺灣海峽中線，侵擾西南、東部空域。
國防部表示，國軍運用執行任務的軍機、軍艦及岸置飛彈系統，對偵獲的中國軍機與軍艦進行嚴密監控與應處。
本站統計紀錄顯示，11月22日的前一次紀錄為17架次中國軍機及11艘中國軍艦。

en.title: Taiwan reports five Chinese military aircraft sorties crossing Taiwan Strait median line
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry reported six Chinese military aircraft sorties, five crossing the median line, and 12 vessels.
body: Taiwan's defense ministry said six Chinese military aircraft sorties and 12 Chinese military vessels were detected between 6 a.m. on November 22 and 6 a.m. on November 23. Five of the aircraft sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and entered airspace to Taiwan's southwest and east.
The ministry said Taiwan's armed forces used aircraft and vessels on assignment, as well as shore-based missile systems, to monitor and respond to the activity.
SKYTICAL's statistical record lists 17 Chinese military aircraft sorties and 11 Chinese military vessels in its previous entry, dated November 22.
